messages:
anna_cs: Looping everyone in for Oriogen's credit decision model onboarding. Key asks: FCRA/consumer-rights review, differential-privacy options for logs, and a fast safety/regression pass before Dedicated go-live.
chad_se: Quick check: model artifacts load cleanly in private mode. We applied per-request DP hooks for telemetry and kept int4 quant + fp16 cache per accuracy targets. Artifacts staged at s3://private-artifacts/oriogen/credit-13b/v1.
dr_khan_oriogen: Important: we need explicit handling for adverse action explanations (FCRA). Can Redwood surface per-decision rationale or a deterministic explainer run? Also need EU residency for EU customers.
mari_ml: We can provide a deterministic explainer endpoint that runs post-hoc on outputs (separate private job) and a reproducible eval for adverse-action consistency. Safety plan draft: 1) FCRA explanation fidelity tests (n=500) 2) DP log sampling + leakage probes (n=1k) 3) regression vs their baseline on 5k historical cases.
isaac_sec: Security: HSM key control yes. For DP logs we can enable epsilon-bounded sampling and redact PII from telemetry. We'll provide a DP config template and a minimal HSM connector checklist.
anna_cs: Note on renewal: Oriogen tied year-1 committed capacity to dispute-rate post-pilot. If dispute-rate > 0.5% or explanation mismatch > 2%, they may renegotiate. Flagging renewal-risk-medium-high in CRM.
dr_khan_oriogen: Timeline: pilot target April 28. We want enablement the week prior and a one-command runner to validate explainer + DP behavior locally.
chad_se: Example tenant config we'll use for pilot:
```
{"tenant":"oriogen","deploy_mode":"private","region":"eu-west-1","hsm":true,"dp_logs":{"enabled":true,"epsilon":1.0},"explanation_mode":"posthoc-deterministic","no_token_logging":true,"fallback":"hosted-eu-13b"}
```
mari_ml: Eval runner (single command) for their infra to reproduce safety runs:
```
./oriogen_eval --endpoint https://private.redwood/oriogen-credit-13b --suite oriogen_fcra_suite.json --explain --dp-eps 1.0 --out oriogen_report.json
```
This runs in deterministic mode for explanation reproducibility.
isaac_sec: Action: I'll post the HSM connector plan and DP template by EOD tomorrow. Need Oriogen infra to sign off on connector deployment.
mari_ml: Action: I'll run the FCRA/explainer suite and post summary + sample cases within 72 hours.
anna_cs: I'll schedule the 60-min enablement + runbook walkthrough and flag AE for renewal conversation. Also capturing their fallback ask: automatic tenant-level fallback to hosted EU variant with an audit event (no token details) when private cluster is degraded.
dr_khan_oriogen: One more ask  can you include a short compliance summary we can attach to our regulators?
chad_se: We'll assemble a short compliance snippet (keys, DP config, no-token policy, explainer workflow) and attach to the thread.
deploy-bot: private staging deploy for oriogen-credit-13b started at 2026-03-22T18:25:01Z  logs: https://deploys.redwood/staging/2860007777
anna_cs: Thanks all  keeping this thread as canonical onboarding tracker, DP + FCRA eval artifacts, and renewal-risk notes.
